purpose: rank() per partition (WindowAgg over a Sort)
sql:
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT c_nationkey, c_name, c_acctbal,
           rank() OVER (PARTITION BY c_nationkey ORDER BY c_acctbal DESC) AS rnk
    FROM customer) ranked
WHERE rnk <= 3
